set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: write inventory-api app ==="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-api.py >/dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import http.server
import json
import socketserver
import os
import time

START = time.time()
PORT = 8080

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = json.dumps({
            "service": "inventory-api",
            "status": "ok",
            "pid": os.getpid(),
            "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1),
            "items": [{"sku": "widget-1", "qty": 42}, {"sku": "widget-2", "qty": 7}],
        }).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

class ThreadingServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    allow_reuse_address = True

if __name__ == "__main__":
    with ThreadingServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler) as httpd:
        httpd.serve_forever()
PYEOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-api.py

echo "=== STEP 2: systemd unit with OOM protection ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service >/dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/inventory-api.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
# Protect from the OOM killer: minimum badness score so it is the last
# candidate the kernel considers when reclaiming memory.
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
OOMPolicy=continue
NoNewPrivileges=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF

echo "=== STEP 3: memory hog script (deliberately unprotected) ==="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/memory-hog.py >/dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import time

chunks = []
mb = bytearray(1024 * 1024)
try:
    while True:
        buf = bytearray(10 * 1024 * 1024)
        for i in range(0, len(buf), 4096):
            buf[i] = 1
        chunks.append(buf)
        time.sleep(0.05)
except MemoryError:
    while True:
        time.sleep(1)
PYEOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/memory-hog.py

echo "=== STEP 4: enable + start inventory-api ==="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-api.service

sleep 1
echo "=== VERIFY: service active ==="
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-api.service
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-api.service -p MainPID -p OOMScoreAdjust

PID=$(sudo -n systemctl show inventory-api.service -p MainPID --value)
echo "MainPID=$PID"
echo "=== VERIFY: oom_score_adj in /proc ==="
cat /proc/$PID/oom_score_adj

echo "=== VERIFY: curl endpoint ==="
curl -s "http://$NODE_IP:8080/" ; echo
